summary: FirstService Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer filing on Form 40-F, furnished a Form 6-K dated October 30, 2026 carrying its unaudited interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. No transaction terms appear: quarterly revenue was $1.53 billion, net earnings attributable to the Company $42.9 million or $0.99 diluted per share, and the filing notes the statements were neither audited nor reviewed by PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, stake, price or closing date is stated. Watch only for ordinary operating trends and acquisition-related items.
